results.title: Duleep Trophy starts with a question mark on relevance
results.description: The significance of the Duleep Trophy is under scrutiny following the ousting of national selectors from the team selection process. Delhi opener Sanat Sangwan faced a surprising benching despite impressive performances in the Ranji Trophy. Former selectors emphasise the need for their participation to ensure equitable player development and mitigate political influences.

results.title: Police investigate after five bodies found in rural area outside Portland, Oregon
results.description: Detectives do not believe it was a random act of violence, authorities said, without sharing much detail. No arrests have been made and no one was in custody.

results.title: Africa’s gold mining site that killed over 100 shut down
results.description: Bangui, Aug 23: The Central African Republic’s government on Saturday closed down a gold mining site that killed more than 100 people when it collapsed earlier this week, citing non-compliance with regulatory procedures.
